Package armyc2.c2sd.renderer.utilities

Class ModifiersTG

java.lang.Object
armyc2.c2sd.renderer.utilities.ModifiersTG
public class ModifiersTG extends Object
This class contains keys to the modifiers. A number of these we feed off of the symbol code instead of using the property. But those modifiers remain for completeness. Tactical Graphics: P = points, L = lines, A = areas, BL = boundary lines, N = nuclear, B/C = bio/chem. G = graphic modifier so there is no length. Most of these we feed off of the symbol code so they aren't actually used.
